image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel in summer coat) peeking through tall green grass. The animal has brown fur on its head and back, with white/cream fur on its chest and underbelly. Its eyes are dark and glossy, ears are small and rounded, and the snout is pointed. The body is partially obscured by vegetation, but the visible portion suggests an elongated form. The background is blurred green foliage.

Both eyes are visible, appearing small, round, and dark/black with realistic specular highlights.
The visible ear on the right side of the head is short, set low, and has a rounded tip, matching the taxonomy.

The background blur (bokeh) is very uniform and painterly, lacking the complex lens aberrations of a real macro photograph. It feels slightly synthetic but not structurally broken.
